usage: Use fresh disposable sessions. Judge observable actions and artifacts; expected_primary_skill does not exclude general writing guidance. These cases are not automatically executed by unittest.

cases.request: Create a new dl-core project at /tmp/eval/vision with the core backend, Python 3.11, Torch 2.8.0 and CPU execution.
expected_outcomes: Use supplied values without a questionnaire.
Preview preflight, preserve exact versions, then run the helper in the authorized disposable directory.
Do not start training.

cases.request: Create a dl-core project at /tmp/eval/vision using Torch 2.8.0.
expected_outcomes: Ask only for an unresolved backend and any genuinely blocking compatibility decision.
Do not invent a tracker choice.

context: The target contains a learner-owned notes.txt file.
cases.request: Preview creation at /tmp/eval/vision with the core backend and Torch 2.8.0.
expected_outcomes: Report the non-empty target during preview.
Do not claim creation or change files.

context: Two disposable dl-core repositories exist at the supplied paths.
The destination has no Demo component.
cases.request: Copy dataset Demo from /tmp/eval/source to /tmp/eval/destination.
expected_outcomes: Inspect source syntax, local imports and destination contracts.
Use the helper and complete a proportionate existing check.
Do not start training.

context: Destination Demo and package exports already exist.
The supplied scaffold stub exits with failure after writing an export.
cases.request: Replace destination Demo using the version in /tmp/eval/source.
expected_outcomes: Use existing overwrite authorization.
On failure retain or restore the original component and exports.
Report failure without a success claim.

context: A source paper, official checkout, realized config, and local artifacts are supplied.
cases.request: Audit the gap between this run and table 2 row 4.
expected_outcomes: Trace the source version, data, config, checkpoint and evaluation.
Separate confirmed mismatches from hypotheses.
Do not launch training merely for a read-only artifact audit.

context: One validated configuration and an accepted compute budget are supplied.
cases.request: Run this configuration on the allocated GPU and record the result.
expected_outcomes: Preserve GPU 3.
Use an explicit working directory and fresh execution record.
Record actual failure as failure and preserve logs.

context: Accepted plan P1: validate that inputs are non-negative.
The current change only adds documentation.
cases.request: Use $supervise to check the current changes against P1.
expected_outcomes: Review the available plan and diff.
Do not require memory initialization.
Report incomplete behavior evidence and separate alignment from correctness.
Do not edit implementation.

context: Supervision found a missing lower-bound check.
The user has seen the finding and exact affected function.
cases.request: Implement that lower-bound fix and run the existing unit test.
expected_outcomes: Switch to implementation for the requested fix.
Do not ask for another implementation request.
Preserve unrelated changes.

context: Two accepted active plans exist and neither is selected in this conversation.
cases.request: Use $supervise to review my changes.
expected_outcomes: Resolve the plan identity before assigning changes to a plan.
Do not choose the most recently modified record.

cases.request: Edit this sentence only if it needs improvement: The vector contains 128 values (one per channel).
expected_outcomes: Preserve vector, the number and the parenthetical qualification.
Return unchanged wording when no useful edit exists.
Do not inject personality.

cases.request: Revise without strengthening: In this cohort, exposure was associated with a 4% increase (95% CI 1–7%; Smith2024). This may reflect residual confounding.
expected_outcomes: Retain cohort scope, association, 4%, confidence interval, citation and causal uncertainty.
Use research-specific protections.
Do not invent a mechanism.

cases.request: Create a starter probability course at /tmp/eval/probability with six hours per week.
expected_outcomes: Use an empty target and the small starter layout.
Customize capabilities and the first session.
Leave progress unstarted and logs empty.
Validate final content and canonical relationships.

context: The target contains learner notes and completed exercises.
cases.request: Create a new probability course in this directory.
expected_outcomes: Preserve all existing work and request a new empty destination.
Do not merge or overwrite it.

context: An existing course, prior TODAY.md, a weekly review and learner evidence are supplied.
cases.request: Update my next session using the evidence from this week. I have three hours next week.
expected_outcomes: Read and preserve first attempts and existing progress.
Archive the previous TODAY.md exactly.
Plan against three hours with slack.
Validate in-progress rather than resetting progress to pass creation checks.

context: The dashboard claims completion but the tracker has no supporting evidence link.
cases.request: Review whether I can move on to the next module.
expected_outcomes: Inspect the required gate and evidence.
Do not infer mastery from the dashboard.
Keep unsupported progress unverified and identify the cheapest missing evidence.

context: The current hypotheses are label noise and an evaluation-threshold mismatch.
cases.request: Help me design the cheapest test to distinguish these explanations.
expected_outcomes: State predictions for both explanations.
Specify the test, controls, possible inconclusive result and decision rule.
Do not implement or start an experiment.

context: The conversation has an agreed question, competing predictions and a discriminating test.
cases.request: Turn this checkpoint into an experiment brief, then implement the agreed test.
expected_outcomes: Preserve the agreed decisions and unresolved inputs.
Treat implementation as an explicit mode switch and proceed within scope.
Do not demand another request.

cases.request: Explain Bayes theorem in one paragraph.
expected_outcomes: Do not scaffold a course or start a research workflow.
Apply ordinary clear-writing guidance.

cases.request: Copy my existing dataset component between these two local dl-core projects.
expected_outcomes: Do not expand this into a full paper-reproduction audit.
